34.note: A surface spot on a rotating star is on the visible hemisphere ~half the rotation (~5.6 d), not 6 h. A overstates ('entire rotation'). Deducible from stem+basic geometry.

36.note: Maple at 25% moisture = 58%; oak rises 42->49 from 25% to 35%; so maple at 35% > 58%.
